demos.name: Highland Tactics 3D
demos.description: A single-hero tactical RPG: explore three authored 21×17 zones with click-to-path routes, roaming skeleton patrols and shopkeeper NPCs, then fight 6 AP / 3 MP tactical battles alone. Each level grants 5 attribute points; AP and MP only grow through rare gear and capped permanent scrolls. Separate Inventory (tabs, search, sort, weight and rich item cards) and Equipment (11-slot paper doll, stat breakdown, AP/MP budget, Fire/Poison/Arcane resistances) panels, a radar minimap, a world log and a PC combat dock. Offline is the default and needs no server; with the companion Node.js + SQLite server, LAN and Online modes add accounts, shared zones with other players, zone chat and server-checked shops, gear and battles. Heroes, enemies, weapons, buildings and props are CC0 KayKit models; the licenses ship with the build.
demos.controls: Walk with WASD/arrows or click any reachable tile. F or the Talk icon interacts with nearby vendors. C character & attributes (arrows + Enter or the + buttons spend points), I inventory (/ search, [ ] tabs, double-click or Enter to use/equip), E equipment (arrows pick slot and item, Enter equips), K skill graph, M world map, B settings/control modes. In PC and Tablet battles, 1 basic attack, 2–7 class skills, 8–0 Potion/Ether/Antidote; hover a slot or an enemy to preview, click a tile to move, Space passes the turn, right-click or Escape cancels. V opens the optional tactical ring; Console and Mobile use radial commands. Q/O orbit, T rain, R retry (Offline), H help. Signed in to a server, / opens zone chat.

demos.name: Aether Observatory 3D
demos.description: Native WebGL floating islands with CC0 KayKit forest trees, bushes and rocks, shaded architecture, fog, physics traversal, orbit/chase cameras and a skippable cinematic.
demos.controls: Move with WASD/arrows or the left stick. Jump with Space/Enter or A. Look with right-mouse drag, Q/E, or the right stick. Change camera mode with C or Y. Touch uses the left virtual stick, JUMP, a right-side swipe, and CAMERA.

demos.name: Cinematic Crossing 2D
demos.description: Parallel camera, zoom and fade tracks, waypoint movement, dialogue cues and clean skip/replay control states.
demos.controls: Replay with Space/Enter or A; skip with Escape or B. Walk after the scene with A/D, arrows, or the left stick. H, R3, or HELP opens the guide; touch provides PLAY, SKIP, a virtual stick, and HELP.

demos.name: Route Atlas 2D
demos.description: A branching overworld graph, smooth node travel, playable shard trials and event-driven stage unlocks.
demos.controls: Navigate with WASD/arrows or the left stick/D-pad; touch uses a virtual stick or taps an adjacent node. Enter a stage with Space/Enter or A; Escape or B returns to the map. R resets and H opens help; touch provides ENTER, BACK, RESET, and HELP.

demos.name: Boss Patterns 2D
demos.description: A three-phase boss with aimed fans, rings, marked charges, delayed hazards, pooled projectiles and dash invulnerability.
demos.controls: Move with WASD/arrows or the left stick. Hold Space/Enter or A to fire at the boss. Dash with C or Y. R retries and H opens help; touch provides FIRE, DASH, RETRY, and HELP.

demos.name: Storm Foundry FX Lab 2D
demos.description: Layered rain, reactive water reflections, dynamic props, bounded particle pools and an in-engine live FX playground.
demos.controls: Drag and release in the world to throw a prop; Space or DROP drops one. B/BURST triggers particles, G/GUST adds wind, L/OPEN FX LAB toggles the lab, and [ / ] change presets. Use arrows or drag sliders to tune controls; Q/E changes tabs, I toggles debug, T telemetry, R resets, and H opens help. Gamepad and mobile buttons are documented in the in-game controls.

demos.name: Toon Adventure 3D
demos.description: A Toon ABS sandbox with two large lakes, linked warp gates, five sentries and shallow-water interaction.
demos.controls: Move with WASD/arrows or the left stick. Space or the left face button attacks. H/Start opens help; R/the top face button resets; B/Select changes lighting.

demos.name: Platformer Building Blocks 2D
demos.description: Two compact stages demonstrating tile collision, jump buffering, coyote time, collection and level transitions.
demos.controls: Move with A/D, arrows, the left stick, or D-pad. Jump with Space or A. R/Y resets; Enter/Start advances after all coins are collected. H/Select opens the in-engine field guide. Mobile uses the virtual stick and jump/help buttons.

demos.name: Movement & Collision 2D
demos.description: A compact 2D example for movement, collision, and collection.
demos.controls: Move and collect with keyboard WASD/arrows or a gamepad left stick/D-pad.

demos.name: Component Adventure 2D
demos.description: Top-down movement, reusable entity components, and room camera transitions.
demos.controls: Keyboard and gamepad movement/action mappings are defined in the current config/game.config.json. Explore rooms and attack slimes.

demos.name: Platform Adventure 2D
demos.description: Platform combat, patrol and pursuit AI, line of sight, inventory, skills and manifest-authored stages.
demos.controls: Keyboard/gamepad controls cover menus, movement, jumping, and combat. See the current config/game.config.json; the in-game HUD shows action and status feedback.

demos.name: Tactical RPG 2D
demos.description: A turn-based grid game with pathfinding, movement range, and combat.
demos.controls: Keyboard/gamepad controls navigate menus and the grid and confirm or cancel actions. Mouse interaction is handled by the framework where available.

demos.name: Fighting Arena 2D
demos.description: Energy spheres, meter-powered supers, buffered melee chains, reactive CPU, local versus and four character profiles.
demos.controls: Player 1: A/D to move, W to jump, S to guard; J/Z light, K/X heavy, L/C energy sphere, U/Q super, H help, Escape menu. Player 2: Left/Right, Up, Down; 1/Numpad1 light, 2/Numpad2 heavy, 3/Numpad3 sphere, 0/Numpad0 super, H help, Escape menu. Standard gamepad uses the left stick/D-pad, A to jump, LB/D-pad down to guard, X/Y/RB/RT for attacks, Start help, and Select/Back for the menu.

demos.name: Puzzle Battle 2D
demos.description: An arcade puzzle game with combos and competitive block exchanges.
demos.controls: A/D moves, W rotates, S drops, R retries, and P pauses. Gamepad uses the D-pad, A to rotate, Y to retry, and Start to pause. The right board is CPU-controlled. Native touch buttons expose movement, rotate/drop, pause, retry, and help.

demos.name: Renderer Showcase 3D
demos.description: A rain-soaked basin with planar reflections, wet surfaces, and interactive lighting.
demos.controls: Open Render controls from the canvas, press H, or use gamepad Start. Drag the camera, light, and rain sliders. Keyboard/gamepad arrows select and adjust; Enter or the south face button toggles. T or the left shoulder toggles rain. Use the panel to switch Basin, inspect materials, lighting, reflections, and telemetry.

demos.name: Solar System 3D
demos.description: Procedural celestial materials, sunlight, and animated planetary orbits.
demos.controls: Camera actions are defined in config/game.config.json; orbit animation runs automatically. H or gamepad Start opens the in-engine controls and scene guide.

demos.name: Sky Trail 3D
demos.description: Four expeditions, a gamepad-ready 3D menu, moving platforms, checkpoints and collectibles.
demos.controls: Move with WASD/arrows or the left stick. Space/A jumps, Shift/RT runs, Q/E or the right stick moves the camera, H/Y opens help, and R/L3 resets. The menu supports D-pad and stick navigation.

demos.name: Online Sandbox 2D
demos.description: Cooperative mining/building, dedicated server rooms, predicted movement and mobile controls; backend required.
demos.controls: Move with A/D or arrows; gamepad left stick/D-pad; touch left virtual stick. Variable-height jump: Space/W/Up, gamepad A, or hold JUMP. Mine with Q/left click, gamepad X, or MINE. Place a block with F/right click, gamepad B, or BUILD.
demos.unavailableMessage: Multiplayer / Requires Backend Server. Online Sandbox needs a separately running backend. No public backend URL has been verified, so this page does not load or claim a playable network build.

demos.name: Addon Building Blocks 2D
demos.description: Shared parallax layers and a patrol/rest state machine using the standard framework lifecycle.
demos.controls: This example runs automatically to demonstrate parallax and patrol/rest behavior; no gameplay input is required.

demos.name: Touch Garden 2D
demos.description: Mobile building blocks: identified multi-touch, a virtual stick, a simultaneous dash action, collision and collectible entities.
demos.controls: Drag the left thumb to steer and use the second thumb for DASH. Tap ? for help or R to reset. Keyboard uses WASD/arrows plus Space/H/R; gamepad uses stick/D-pad plus A/Start/Y.
